gen-gf-bellota-gf-alef: Quirky and unswelling: Bellota traces every curve at one stylus width. Alef's open-ended curves keep the text moving, so a whole page would read lightly and without fuss or strain.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: The text opens up through a welcoming gap in each c, contemporary in tone. Alegreya Sans SC takes that sans-serif role under Bellota, whose strokes show no thick-thin swing at all.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-almarai: Bellota arrives with hanging s ends and a line traced at one stylus width, distinctive and commanding. Almarai, with unswelling lines and letters that never pinch shut, gives it a tidy sans-serif partner on the page.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-amarna: Amarna keeps every stroke contrast-free, contemporary and clean, from stem to terminal. Beneath Bellota's commanding display lettering, Amarna's unclogged small counters let a full page of sans-serif text flow along without snagging.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-andika: Andika gives tails and terminals the full thickness of its stems, with wide, easy turns through every s, beneath Bellota's heading. What they share most is a uniform, unhurried line.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-anta: Anta has gaping mouths on the e and a wire-bent, sign-like look at constant thickness, beneath Bellota's hanging-ended display type. Both commit to a single, unwavering line weight throughout.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-antic: Antic reads as though one nib drew it, mouths left open. Bellota's stylus-width strokes and far-hanging s share that single-tool feel, so the sans-serif text and display heading sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ar-one-sans: Bellota's s hangs its ends far from the spine, every stroke traced at one stylus gauge. AR One Sans, with brush ends lifting away before each curve closes, does the text work while Bellota handles display drama.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-assistant: Distinctive from the first letter: Bellota's s hangs its ends wide. Assistant holds the mouths of c, e, and a open beneath it, and Bellota's steady pen pressure carries the pair from heading to text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-asta-sans: Approachable first, Asta Sans draws tubelike, constant-weight lines with e letters you never mistake for a blot. And Bellota, with s ends hanging far out, takes the display work.
